text:
leah: shelf-31 showing NVMe write storms and NIC tx_tail spikes. 99p gen latency jumped from ~140ms -> ~1.9s at ~04:22 UTC. Filing here for quick sync.
omar: I see host io_saturation on host-31-4 and kvcache regen across several pods. Likely a tenant doing parallel dataset ingest + heavy checkpointing.
ravi: quick triage checklist: 1) identify top writers on shelf-31 2) apply 5% fallback to warm-reserve 3) apply per-tenant soft shaping for top offenders 4) consider +1 GPU padding for the slice if peak recurring.
sophia: run the query for top writers please. also can we avoid immediate migration unless shaping fails? migrations spike egress and make things worse sometimes.
infra-bot: top_writers (last 12m): ["tenant-603","tenant-824","tenant-1702"], avg_write_iops [6200,4300,900].
leah: thanks. ravi, apply 5% fallback canary to warm-reserve-eu-west and tag with incident=INF-9008.
ravi: running fallback canary now:
```
curl -s -X POST "http://router-api.local/v1/routing/fallback" -d '{"from":"slice-dedicated-88","to":"warm-reserve-eu-west","fraction":0.05}'
```
sophia: also propose shaping tenant-603 to 100Mbps and tenant-824 to 80Mbps for 20m. if 99p < 300ms after 8m we expand fallback to 30%.
omar: agree. apply shaping and lower spillback_window to 40s to reduce oscillation during the canary. sample shape payload:
```
# shape tenant
curl -X POST http://router-api.local/v1/tenants/603/shape -d '{"bandwidth_mbps":100,"spillback_secs":40}'
```
infra-bot: [ACTION] 04:25 UTC fallback 5% applied to slice-dedicated-88 by ravi. Telemetry tag=INF-9008. 99p reduced to ~320ms within 70s; nvme_write_q trending down.
leah: good win. proceed with shaping for the two tenants. keep migration as last resort. also tagging tenant-603 with "io-heavy" for monitoring.
ravi: shaping applied. will monitor 8m then if stable bump fallback to 30%. note: warm-reserve cost delta ~+$520/hr at 50% load; 30% for short windows acceptable within incident budget.
sophia: ops follow-up items: - add SLI for shelf_nvme_queue_depth > 60% for 3m - consider slice padding policy: during region peaks, add +1 GPU to folio-class slices (eu-west night window). Estimate monthly delta ~$4.8k. propose trial for 2 weeks.
omar: +1 on SLI and trial padding. also request a quarantine rule draft: if tenant triggers >2 NVMe spikes (10m windows) in 12h, auto-move to fractional carveout and alert account team. document consequences for customers.
infra-bot: 04:32 UTC canary at 5% shows 99p ~280ms, error rate stable. ready to scale fallback per runbook.
leah: scale to 30% now and watch warm-reserve 99p. rollback if >700ms.
ravi: scaling to 30%...
infra-bot: 04:34 UTC fallback increased to 30%. 99p obs: slice-dedicated-88 ~170ms; warm-reserve 99p ~240ms. nvme queue depth down 45%.
sophia: nice. please capture iostat + dmesg + router logs to INF-9008. run isolation test in 40m if noise reappears. also add a dashboard panel for per-shelf kvcache regen.
leah: opened INF-9008 and attached initial telemetry. thanks team. will coordinate post-incident notes and cost ask for temporary padding. if this repeats after the trial we propose a regional capacity increase. :thumbsup:
